_comment: Example: a metric claim that names a specific system and percentage but has no matching entry in canonical identity files. Verdict is 'unknown' (not 'mismatch') because the claim cannot be confirmed OR denied from available canonical sources — the specific uptime figure for that system is simply not present. Flags for human review rather than blocking.

input.claim: 99.99% uptime on the visitor management system at Acme Corp
input.context_excerpt: The visitor management platform I led achieved 99.99% uptime across 400+ Acme Corp sites globally.

output.claim: 99.99% uptime on the visitor management system at Acme Corp
output.canonical_excerpt:
Led 14-vendor global evaluation for Data Center Visitor Management.
[No uptime figure for visitor management system found in canonical]
output.diff: The visitor management system is referenced in canonical (§ 4.3 Platform Engineering section) but no uptime metric is recorded for it. Canonical does contain uptime-adjacent metrics for other systems (system-A: 400% performance improvement; system-B: 51,840,000% efficiency gain) but none matching '99.99% uptime' for visitor management. Cannot confirm or deny from available canonical files.
output.remediation: One of three options: (1) Remove the specific uptime figure until the user can confirm it from memory and add it to experience-history.md. (2) Replace with the verifiable canonical metric: 'Led the 14-vendor global evaluation for the Data Center Visitor Management system.' (3) Provide source documentation and request canonical update before ship. Do NOT ship the 99.99% figure without canonical anchor.
